entries.result: Powerful artifacts bestowed upon the townsfolk by an ancient god are hidden in secret locations around the Town.
An unknown and abandoned building was found on the outskirts of Town. Its location is inaccurate, since each person reported seeing it at a different site.
Ancient prophecies, foretelling the rise of a chosen one who will bring a new era of darkness and reshape the world, have been carried out.
The townsfolk are preparing to return to their ancestral home.
An underground tunnel under the Town Hall connects the current Town to the original Town.
The gatherings held at the Circle of Stones are attended by inhuman creatures.
The Town’s religious order is about to complete the ritual to bring a Cosmic Entity back to this reality.
